parent_objective: design a fair L0 L1 L2 L3 controller comparison before any GRU-first paper claim or controller training
blocked_by: paper route needs fair current feedback finite-window and GRU comparison before training or recurrent-belief claims
supersedes: assuming the online GRU is the mainline answer without finite-window baselines
invalidates: training L3 only before fixing L0 L1 L2 baselines and gate usage
claiming self-identification from GRU success without finite-window comparison

public_gates: M1187 may design controller families and evaluation splits only
M1187 must not train controller weights
M1187 must not run candidate replay
M1187 must not use private holdout
M1187 must not change actor-input contract
forbidden_shortcuts: do not train L0 L1 L2 or L3
do not give any actor hidden or oracle inputs
do not claim GRU superiority from design

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_design: fair L0 L1 L2 L3 controller comparison contract
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: defines fair controller families observation windows capacity controls task families and gate usage before training
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: experiment design only; no training replay PPO promotion private-holdout driver-performance recurrent-belief or paper-result claim
stop_condition: stop if any variant receives hidden or oracle actor inputs
stop if finite-window baselines are weaker by design rather than fair challengers
stop if gate usage is unspecified
fallback_plan: if controller implementation support is missing, route to controller scaffold implementation after design
if task splits are under-specified, route to dataset split design before training
if parameter budgets cannot be matched, report model-size and inference-cost controls explicitly
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1186 active gate policy admits L0/L1/L2/L3 design as the next paper-route step

training_stage.stage_objective: design L0 L1 L2 L3 controller comparison
admission_evidence: M1182a requires fair finite-window versus GRU comparison
M1186 defines active gate policy and permits design under Stack A process gates
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review artifacts
next_stage_criteria: L0 L1 L2 L3 variants are specified
same deployable input contract is enforced
capacity and inference-cost reporting is specified
task families and splits are specified
Stack A/B trigger rules are specified
next implementation or dataset-design milestone is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1187 is a design milestone. It must explicitly include L0 and L1 current-response controls to test current-frame substitution in later experiments.
history_necessity_tests: future same-current same-recent-window different-older-history tests must be included
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1187 should specify finite windows 0.25s 0.5s 1.0s and 2.0s plus GRU reset/truncation controls for later experiments.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If design cannot make L2 a fair challenger to L3 route to controller scaffold or dataset design rather than training GRU-only.
allowed_claims: no self-identification, driver capability, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: A fair L0/L1/L2/L3 comparison design can separate current-response feedback, finite-window history, and GRU recurrent belief before training or paper claims.
success_criteria: controller variants L0 L1 L2 L3 are specified
same deployable actor-input contract is specified for all variants
capacity and inference-cost controls are specified
task families and train/eval splits are specified
gate policy from docs/active-gate-policy.md is applied
no controller training, candidate replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input change occurs
failure_criteria: design gives hidden or oracle actor inputs to any variant
design does not specify task splits or gate usage
controller training, candidate replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input change starts
decision_rule: M1187 passes if it defines the fair controller comparison contract and next implementation or dataset milestone without training or changing actor inputs.
